title: Gossamer Moonfairy

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered Hanfu-inspired couture with a fitted wrap bodice, flowing floor-length skirt tiers, sheer trailing side panels, and voluminous bell sleeves with asymmetric hem.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Floral hairpins with pearlescent buds, gilded leaf clips, delicate dangling bead tassels, and a translucent ribbon tied at the side of the head.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Pastel peach wrap bodice with a high crossed collar, gold thread embroidery, sheer organza overlay, tiny pearl buttons, and wide layered bell sleeves with scalloped cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered floor-length skirt in graduated pastel hues with pleated underlayers, sheer chiffon overskirt panels, subtle cloud embroidery, and delicate pearl-trimmed hem, paired with soft flat slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Ornate gold filigree fan with moon and cloud motifs, floating translucent ribbon streamers, and scattered maple-leaf accents.
